decisions.reason: As a dietary supplement range closely related to our existing consumer health and OTC capabilities, it fits our knowledge base well enough that we can learn from the early launch and refine it commercially.

This skin and hair supplement builds directly on established portfolio and pharmacy-channel know-how, and its dedicated launch presence suggests enough initial promise to justify further development and market learning.

Joint-health supplements are close to our existing competencies, so our absorptive capacity and in-house development resources make it sensible to keep the product and improve positioning rather than exit early.

Although the mushroom-based immune concept is somewhat more niche, it still builds on our established supplement business and gives us a related area in which our R&D and quality capabilities can support further learning.

Because this generic blood pressure product is relatively distant from the knowledge base highlighted for these launches and already showed an early problem signal, the resources are better redeployed to areas where we can absorb information and improve performance more effectively.
